lines.text: i saw my name in the sink next to the ring marks
and reins
half a heart in the laundry a blue thread pulled from the
pain
i held the loose edges gently like they might cut me again
but
every shot knew my fingerprint every crack knew where i′ve been i
was gone in a thousand
ways scattered under my own skin then i heard a small voice
say pick it up begin i′m finding
my shattered pieces piece by piece i breathe i′m finding my shattered
pieces who broke me now
i keep keep me i′m finding my shattered pieces and i′m not
afraid to say i was never all gone
i was just coming back to me i swept the floor with
my shadow felt the cold on my knees found
the damage like a map through the debris i was bruised like
a rumor i was a doubt like
a crown i learned how to hold
my own hands when the whole world
let me down i was gone in a
